descriptionChirho: To invoke God's favor upon a person or group, pronouncing a blessing; the active transitive act of blessing another (God blessing people, or people blessing others).
To be in a state of divine favor or blessedness; used in passive voice or as a perfect participle describing one who has received God's blessing.
To speak well of God, to praise or give thanks; blessing directed upward toward God rather than outward toward people.
